page.overview:
Who is Natsu Ayuhara?

Natsu Ayuhara (鮎原 夏 Ayuhara Natsu) is a fighting game character from the Rival Schools games.

In the staff comments of Private Justice Academy School Guide, series director Hideaki Itsuno reveals that he used Shunsuke Aoba and Natsumi Asaoka from The Kabocha Wine as inspiration for Shoma and Natsu. Her surname, Ayuhara, comes from Kozue Ayuhara, protagonist of [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Attack_No._1 Attack No. 1,] and her overall appearance is modeled after Olympic volleyball player Motoko Obayashi.

Natsu is a smart and outspoken person seen by many of her schoolmates as a sister figure. With a sharp personality, she dislikes liars and people who uses any form of bullying against the weak. And because she acts more of a man than a girl, many boys in school are afraid of her, but her female schoolmates almost inundate her with love letters every day. She has a secret crush on Shoma who she argues with almost everyday.

In the School Life Mode of Nekketsu Seisyun Nikki 2, Natsu is initially very calm and serious during the first meeting, being challenged by Shoma to a beach volleyball game as well as showing her seriousness when she demonstrates her volleyball skills towards her coach, Kohtaro Okita near the end of the mode itself. During the school term, Natsu shows more of her personality aside from being smart and outspoken, in that she's also a happy, cheerful, and fun-loving woman, aiding and helping out Roberto, Nagare, and Mari Nanase during the School Fair Day.
